definitions.explanation: Used to single out one item from a group as being particularly notable. Slightly more formal than 特に.

examples.japanese: とりわけ⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧だ。
examples.english: What was especially memorable was the final scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、とりわけ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: Among fruits, I like apples in particular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とりわけ⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧、⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This winter was especially cold, and there was a lot of snow too.

notes:
とりわけ singles out one thing from a group as particularly noteworthy. Can be written as {取|と}り{分|わ}け in kanji, but the hiragana form is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- とりわけ + adjective/verb: especially ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、とりわけ〜: among ~, especially ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧: especially (most common, neutral register)
- とりわけ: especially (slightly more formal/literary)
- {殊|こと}に: especially (formal, literary)
- なか⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: among them, especially (focuses on selecting from a group)
